MAKE YOURSELF COMFORTABLE

Fit your hands.

Sticks appear where you touch. Drag in either lower corner to move or aim.

Weapons reload automatically when empty. Tap the ammo counter for an early reload. Sentry controls appear when you have one.

MORE ROOM FOR THE NIGHT

Give the game the screen.

On iPhone, launch from your Home Screen for a view without Safari’s address and tab bars.

  1. Open in SafariUse the game’s link in the Safari app.
  2. Share → Add to Home ScreenKeep “Open as Web App” on if shown, then tap Add.
  3. Launch the new icon & turn sidewaysIf the screen will not rotate, turn off Portrait Orientation Lock in Control Center.

Your current run stays saved in this browser. Home Screen storage can be separate, so finish a run before switching.

A FIELD GUIDE TO STAYING ALIVE

Keep moving.

Move & shoot

Touch and drag anywhere in the lower left zone to move, or the lower right zone to aim and fire. The sticks form beneath your thumbs. Adjust size and spacing in Pause → Touch controls.

Make room

Dash and healing sit beside the right stick, so your left thumb can keep moving. Dash recharges in a few seconds. Magazines reload automatically; tap the ammo counter to reload early.

Build your loadout

Collect scrap, health, and ammunition. After each wave, collect supplies and tap Open store when ready. Your sidearm stays with you, plus two extra weapons.

Watch the ground

Purple circles warn of arriving enemies. Avoid acid and the boss’s marked attacks. Doors are escape routes—keep one open.

Keyboard: WASD / arrows to move, mouse to aim and shoot, 1–3 weapons, R reload, E heal, Q sentry, Space dash, Esc pause.
Controller: sticks move/aim, RT fire, A dash, X reload, Y heal, B switch, LB sentry, Start pause.

Runs save automatically in this browser. Relaxed mode reduces incoming damage and enemy movement speed.
